authorization: User approved next production-and-comparison plan; no paid API; all research processing scheduled on BU SCC.
scope: Incremental application of frozen rulefirst-v1.2, frozen relation overlay and D57 v2 responsibility gate to actual corpus shards; do not label fixed7635 cache as corpus production.
reuse: Existing global canonical US disposition and source-row locators
Existing Records and O*NET verified joins, subject to precise key reconciliation
Prior whole-corpus T1 and T4 records-lifecycle outputs remain valid within documented scope; sample T4 N/A does not supersede them

first_batch.selection: Deterministic first available canonical shard from existing manifest; not a new statistical sample
first_batch.admission: Verified source path, cached receipt/size, canonical selectors, available BU quota and bounded transport; preserve raw sources
first_batch.execution: BU scheduled CPU job; start bounded, measure actual throughput before expanding concurrency
gate: Actual scheduler exit0 and complete output receipt
Input row conservation and canonical key uniqueness within shard
Source/evidence offsets and schema match frozen code
Unresolved, conditional, empty and failed statuses retained
Idempotent resume uses code+input hashes; no append duplicates

outputs.posting_private: Canonical JOB_HASH/source_file/source_row, metadata key availability, text hash and normalizer version, broad and narrow candidate flags, unknown/review states, completion status
outputs.evidence_private: Literal numeric bounds with object candidates, strength, scope, coordinates and evidence; no fabricated job-level minimum
outputs.metadata: Keep COMPANY_ID as source company identity, current-delivery O*NET and Records lifecycle dates; not corporate-parent identity or historical body time
outputs.public: Counts, status, throughput, code/input provenance, aggregate comparisons; no private keys or advertisement text

measurement_boundary: No semantic rule changes or new model runtime
Current duty mentoring uses D57 gate; prior mentoring remains separate
No-match is not verified absence; role labels remain lexical indicators
Do not collapse degree branches to unconditional job minima
Fulltext and time evidence do not establish historical wording; no causal comparisons

comparison_design.primary: Current saved text within verified O*NET major x Census region support; add source company only if key and overlap actually support it
comparison_design.technology: Nonnegated lexical-family categories with explicit overlap; software-only means no AI detected by frozen lexicon, not no adoption
comparison_design.outcomes: General/related both-four-states; broad/narrow entry wording x responsibility candidates; literal numeric clauses separately
comparison_design.cohorts: CREATED-year stratification descriptive only; never body publication time
comparison_design.support: Report retained/dropped counts before any standardized contrast; skip sparse contrasts rather than redefine groups for significance

execution_roles.root: Core decisions and one first-batch acceptance
execution_roles.Sol_medium: Source/transfer orchestration, wrapper implementation and scheduled run
execution_roles.independent_QA: Keys, conservation, evidence and mapping evidence

stop_rule: Do not launch blind full204m reprocessing. First actual shard must demonstrate correct output and measured resource/storage needs. Continue disjoint admitted shards after acceptance; external transport blocker must be stated, not masked by rerunning sample.
